originalProposedEdit.replacementText:
<div
                role="dialog"
                aria-modal="true"
                aria-labelledby="checkout-modal-title"
                data-testid="checkout-modal"
                id="checkout-modal"
                className="checkout-modal"
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key !== "Tab") return;
                  const container = e.currentTarget;
                  const focusable = Array.from(
                    container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
                      'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
                    )
                  ).filter((el) => !el.hasAttribute("disabled"));
                  if (focusable.length === 0) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    return;
                  }
                  const first = focusable[0];
                  const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
                  if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    last.focus();
                  } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    first.focus();
                  }
                }}
              >
originalProposedEdit.reason: Add Tab/Shift+Tab containment on the dialog element so focus cycles among Close, Email, and Continue instead of escaping to background controls.

originalDiagnosis.repairStrategy: Implement a focus containment strategy that keeps Tab and Shift+Tab cycling within #checkout-modal while it is open, prevents focus from moving to background content, and restores management of initial focus and close behavior.

originalRepairRationale: Observed evidence shows Tab from #checkout-modal-continue escapes to #background-control while modal stays open. Handling Tab/Shift+Tab on the dialog and wrapping first-to-last/last-to-first keeps focus inside #checkout-modal without changing markup semantics, close behavior, or background content.
